reviews.author: Sherry Byrd
reviews.text: Our alternator went out on the way to the beach. We found a new one at the auto parts store, I called these guys because they were close by and they quickly agreed to put it on right then. They were super friendly, knowledgeable, offered the restroom and the dogs a place to rest because it was very hot. I can’t say how thankful I am to have stopped at this safe location with friendly folks who genuinely care about helping others. We appreciate them so much! Now, hopefully we can enjoy the rest of our vacation. Thank you Quality Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Mary Timmons
reviews.text: Took my car there on a Monday and it needed a torque converter he had it done Wednesday evening! My car was under warranty they handled talking with the warranty company and got my car all fixed for a very decent price! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: James Sara
reviews.text: I've been using Quality Auto Repair for 3 years now and they have been excellent. John and Chris are not only two of the most honest mechanics you will ever meet but they are also two of the nicest people you will ever meet. I live in Raleigh now and still drive (or get towed) an hour and a half away to this shop because I know that they will be honest with me and get the job done right the first time! Not to mention they have some of the best repair prices in town!
